Eligibility Criteria :- OPEN TENDER ENQUIRY. 1. Financial Criteria The average annual financial turnover during the last three (03) years ending 31st March 2026 should be at least #6 Lakhs. Documents required to be submitted: Turnover Certificate from a practicing Chartered Accountant (CA), which must include: a) Turnover figures exclusive of GST. b) Unique Document Identification Number (UDIN) and Membership Number of the CA. c) Financial turnover details for the last three financial years: FY 2025-26, FY 2024-25 & FY 2023-24 (ending on 31st March 2026). 2. Technical Eligibility The bidder must have successfully completed or substantially completed similar work during the last seven (07) years ending on the last day of the month previous to the one in which the tender is issued. The eligibility shall be either of the following: Three (03) similar completed works, each costing not less than #7 Lakhs; OR Two (02) similar completed works, each costing not less than #9 Lakhs; OR One (01) similar completed work, costing not less than #14 Lakhs. 3. Experience & Supporting Documents The similar work should pertain to "Mechanical jobs related to repair & maintenance of industrial mixing drums/dampers/valves" and must ha ve been executed in Central Govt. Organizations, State Govt. Organizations, PSUs, Joint Venture Companies (where at least one partner is a Central/State Govt. Organization or PSU), or Public Limited Companies. The following documents must be submitted as proof of experience: i) Self-attested copies of Work Orders. ii) Self-attested copies of Completion Certificates issued by the concerned work executing authority. iii) For substantially completed ongoing works (with a contract duration of more than one year): The bidder should have completed at least one year of the contract duration and at least 50% of the work as per the Work Order. In such cases, the already executed value shall be considered for evaluation. iv) If the work completion certificate does not mention the value of completed work, then RA bills paid or any other relevant docume nt(s) evidencing the executed work value shall also be considered. Additionally, all Work Orders and Completion Certificates/Paid Bills submitted must be in the name of the participating tenderer. Scope of Work The scope of work shall include comprehensive maintenance, inspection, repair, replacement, fabrication, overhauling, alignment, servici ng, testing and commissioning of various mechanical equipment and auxiliary systems of SP-II, including but not limited to the following: 1 Maintenance of Centralized Grease Lubrication Systems comprising Sinter Machine, Pan Conveyor, Cold Sinter Screen Building and Mixi ng & Balling Drum lubrication stations, including repair/replacement/overhauling of ZPU-14 pumps, Multi-line Pumps, pump elements, gre ase reservoir tanks, flywheel mechanisms, grease filters, change-over valves, pressure switches, grease pipelines, arresting leakages, gre ase refilling, cleaning, servicing, testing and restoration of the complete lubrication system. 2 Maintenance of Centralized Oil Lubrication Systems of Sinter Machine, Hot Sinter Screen, Sinter Cooler, Mixing & Balling Drum, Waste Gas Fan and Dedusting Fan, including repair/replacement/overhauling of lubrication pumps, filters, oil tanks, oil pipelines, oil flow control u nits, viewing units, oil nozzles, oil seals, coupling pads, gearboxes, blowers, exciters, oil flushing, oil replacement, oil top-up, leak rectification, alignment, testing and commissioning. 3 Maintenance of Mixing & Balling Drum (MBD) including inspection, adjustment and maintenance of girth gear, pinion, support rollers, th rust rollers, check rollers, scraper blades, air and water spray systems, nozzles, pipelines, static balancing, shell repairs, liner plate weldin g/replacement, expanded metal repair/replacement, lubrication system maintenance, oil and grease pipeline maintenance, gearbox lubri cation maintenance, reservoir servicing, testing and associated fabrication works. 4 Replacement of Weigh Feeder Belts in PB Building, including dismantling, blanking arrangements, removal of old belt, installation of end less belts, idler servicing, tensioning mechanism repair, skirt board and scraper refitting, load testing, alignment, trial run and restoration. 5 Repair, Overhauling and Replacement of Wind Main DCDVs (NB-400) including repair of cone support lever, cone seats, cam levers, seal ing rings, cones, replacement of damaged components, packings, servicing of cam operating mechanism, leakage arresting and testing. 6 Fabrication, Repair and Replacement of Hoppers, Liners, Mother Plates, Structural Members, Platforms and Supporting Steel Structures around Wind main, hoppers and associated equipment, including fabrication, welding, fitment and structural strengthening. 7 Fabrication of Safety Display Boards and Production/Productivity Display Boards of various sizes, including cutting, fabrication, welding, grinding, erection, painting and fixing complete with supporting structures. 8 The work shall include dismantling, shifting, lifting, handling, alignment, machining, welding, gas cutting, grinding, drilling, fitting, erecti on, reassembly, leak testing, lubrication, flushing, cleaning, balancing, adjustment, calibration, trial run and commissioning of equipment as required. 9 Necessary scaffolding, working platforms, tools & tackles, welding equipment, gas cutting sets, consumables, manpower, supervision, cl eaning materials, transportation within plant premises and all incidental arrangements required for safe execution of the work shall be arr anged by the contractor unless specifically supplied by the department. 10 All dismantled scrap and waste materials generated during ex ecution shall be shifted and stacked at locations specified by the Area-in-Charge. 11 All works shall be carried out strictly as per departmental instructions, relevant drawings, site conditions, approved procedures and sta ndard engineering practices. Testing, trial run and satisfactory commissioning shall form an integral part of the activity. Unit of Measurem ent (UOM): Activity Unit (AU) One (01) Activity Unit (AU) shall mean the complete execution of the entire scope of work described above f or a period of one (01) month, including all preventive, shutdown, breakdown, and routine maintenance activities as directed by the Area- in-Charge.
